subject: Request: temporary accelerator alignment & pricing remedy
messages:
From: Sarah Kline <sarah.kline@novalia.ai>
To: jonas.weber@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@novalia.ai
Date: Sat, 05 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: temporary accelerator alignment & pricing remedy

Hi Jonas,

Thanks again for the partnership — we appreciate Redwood standing up the Dedicated pool quickly. We ran a new training sweep on our latest model and are seeing a pronounced performance regression on the A100-backed nodes (higher p99 latency and worse fp16 throughput) for the new micro-batching patterns. Our infra team validated that the model runs well on H100 in local repros.

We need to propose the following to avoid a major customer-impacting incident:
- Temporarily align our reserved capacity to H100 for a 14-day window starting as soon as possible.
- While the swap is active, we request Redwood hold any reservation-related termination/penalty enforcement and provide burst capacity to cover peak ETL runs.
- For the burst/overage during this remediation window, we are requesting a mitigation: waive the first 200 GPU-hours of burst and cap overage surcharge at 2.0x standard rate for the first 48 hours.

We can sign a one-page amendment if you can provide terms and a DocuSign link today. Attached: Novalia_perf_snapshot_0604.xlsx (perf sample) and current SOW for reference.

Can you confirm feasibility and approximate timeline?

Appreciate the quick help — this is time-sensitive for our customer SLA.

Best,
Sarah
Sarah Kline
Head of Infrastructure, Novalia AI

--
Attachment: Novalia_perf_snapshot_0604.xlsx (spreadsheet)
Attachment: Novalia_SOW_v3.pdf (pdf)

From: jonas.weber@redwood.ai
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 05 Jun 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Request: temporary accelerator alignment & pricing remedy

Folks — forwarding Novalia's ask. TL;DR: they want a 14-day temporary switch from A100 -> H100, reservation hold during the window, burst capacity, and a capped overage schedule (waive first 200 GPU-hours, 2.0x cap for 48 hrs). They need a DocuSign amendment asap.

Quick context: Novalia is mid-market with steady dedicated usage, and this swap is driven by a new model path that is incompatible with A100 kernels. We can technically migrate them to an H100-compatible pool but it needs exec-level concession on billing hold/overage cap given the revenue risk.

Proposed internal ask to leadership: approve a one-time concession with the following constraints:
- Duration: 14 calendar days
- Waive first 200 GPU-hours of burst
- Overage surcharge capped at 2.0x for the first 48 hours, revert to standard overage after
- Reservation penalties paused for the window (we classify it as remediation-driven, not contract breach)
- Legal to execute a short amendment and procurement to issue a PO within 48 hours

Please advise with explicit approval or counter-terms. I can draft the DocuSign and customer-facing note.

Thanks,
Jonas
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Jonas —

I reviewed Novalia's perf snapshot and the ask. I approve a timeboxed concession provided we lock in a clean rollback and clear acceptance criteria from Novalia. My conditions:
1) Term: 14 days, start date to be agreed in amendment.
2) Waive first 200 GPU-hours of burst (one-time credit).
3) Overage pricing: capped at 2.0x standard rate for first 48 hours after the swap, then revert to published overage rates.
4) Reservation penalties: pause enforcement for the 14-day window, but no retroactive forgiveness beyond that window.
5) Novalia must sign a 1-page amendment and provide PO within 48 hours of our DocuSign; if PO not received we reserve right to revert immediately.
6) Technical rollback plan and acceptance test: Novalia must provide an acceptance script and target p99 baseline; we will validate within 48 hours and confirm restore to original allocation if not met.

Karthik — please prepare the amendment language and associated billing ledger entry. Marissa, loop legal on the amendment (cc'd). Once the amendment language is drafted, I'll provide formal signoff.

Approved by: Lauren Bishop
VP, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

Hi Sarah —

Thanks for the detail and the perf snapshot. Redwood can accommodate a temporary alignment to H100 and provide a limited billing remedy to enable your remediation work. Please see the agreed terms below:

Agreed temporary terms (14-day window):
- Migration: Redwood will provision equivalent H100 capacity to Novalia's reserved footprint and migrate workloads within 48 hours of amendment execution.
- Reservation hold: enforcement will be paused for the 14-day window.
- Burst/overage mitigation: Redwood will waive the first 200 GPU-hours of burst as a one-time credit. Overage surcharge will be capped at 2.0x standard overage rate for the first 48 hours post-swap, then revert to published overage rates.
- Acceptance & rollback: Novalia to provide acceptance test script and target p99 baseline within 24 hours of swap. If performance does not meet the target within 48 hours after migration, Redwood will revert the allocation or work with Novalia on a follow-up plan.
- Contracting: We will send a 1-page amendment via DocuSign. Novalia must return a signed amendment and PO within 48 hours of the DocuSign.

Next steps (owner):
1) Jonas: draft and send DocuSign amendment (today) — includes terms above and effective date placeholder.
2) Karthik: prepare billing ledger entry for one-time credit and temporary cap.
3) Novalia: share acceptance script and PO.

Link to amendment draft: https://docs.redwood.ai/contracts/DEAL-NA-9873/amendment-draft

If that looks good I will send the DocuSign now.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
